data.text: The complete physical examination excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations, unless clinically indicated. data.text: Perform as indicated based on participant status and standard of care. May be performed by a qualified personnel per local regulations. data.description: Protocol Amendment (e) for Study I6T-MC-AMCD. Substantial amendment incorporating regulatory feedback including terminology updates (mucosal healing replaced with histologic-endoscopic mucosal improvement plus absence of neutrophils), SoA corrections, new exclusion criterion for abnormal ECG, gallbladder disease risk assessment update, AI-based endoscopy scoring details, and mMS appendix update per FDA Guidance 2016. Electronically Signed and Approved by Lilly on 04 Nov 2025 GMT. Document ID: VV-CLIN-168867.

Sponsor: Eli Lilly and Company. IND: 174802. EU trial number: 2024-520209-38-00.
